description: Unshare a website, app, agent, or skill by email: each address's share is revoked, and its link is refused from the person's next request on, including in a browser that already opened it. An agent's chat stream that is already open can run for up to 15 minutes more. Revoking is permanent: sharing again with the same address mails a new link. This cannot be undone, so confirm the addresses with the user first. An address with no share is reported, not refused. Unsharing ends only the share and leaves the access mode as it is: on a public service anyone can still open it, on a password service anyone with the password can, and members of the organization always can. People you did not name keep their own shares. To close the service itself, use set_service_access. Returns the service's access mode and each address with its state: revoked, or no_share when it held no share to revoke. Requires connecting a Valet account.

emails.description: The email addresses whose shares to revoke. Addresses that differ only in case count once.

kind.description: The kind you expect the name to hold. A guard against unsharing the wrong thing: a name that holds another kind is refused and nothing is revoked. Omit to unshare whatever the name holds.

name.description: The website's, app's, agent's, or skill's name, as list_services shows it: the one to unshare.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the website, app, agent, or skill belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: unshare_service

access.description: Who can reach the service, which revoking a share leaves as it was: public, private, or password. On public, anyone can still open it; on password, anyone with the password can; on private, members of the organization can. People you did not name keep their own shares, whatever the mode.

kind.description: Kind of the service whose shares were revoked: site, app, agent, or skill.

name.description: Name of the website, app, agent, or skill whose shares were revoked.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

results.description: One entry per distinct address, in the order the call named them. Repeats that differ only in case appear once.

email.description: The email address, trimmed, as first written in the call.

state.description: revoked when the address's share was revoked, no_share when it held no share to revoke and nothing changed.

title: Stop sharing a website, app, agent, or skill with people
